SELECT 
  AVG(group_pressratio) as avg_compression_ratio,
  AVG(group_size_per_min) as avg_size_per_minute
FROM (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    st.typesite,
    AVG(s.pressratio) as group_pressratio,
    AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) as group_size_per_min
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite
) grouped_data
